hypotheses.change: Enable the existing private cuda_mps daemon for colocated stages.
hypotheses.rationale: Test whether separate stage CUDA contexts prevent useful concurrent kernel execution.
hypotheses.precondition: Baseline stage timing and load observations completed.

hypotheses.change: Enable existing bounded exact-shape encoder capture after startup, with identical precision and chunk semantics.
hypotheses.rationale: Startup continuation capture leaves recurring prompt/tail shapes eager.
hypotheses.precondition: Baseline timing/source attribution supports encoder launch overhead; numerical/state checks and memory budget pass.

hypotheses.change: Compare existing Whole-Euler micro-batch sizes 4 and 8 with otherwise identical settings.
hypotheses.rationale: Larger actual ready batches may amortize graph replay; verify shape/rounding and memory effects.
hypotheses.precondition: Baseline demonstrates multirow decode batches; assess quality independently.

quality_gates.request_completion: All measured requests must finish successfully with nonempty finite audio and no missing/duplicated chunks.
quality_gates.sampling: Keep checkpoint, prompt construction, sampling and output limits fixed.
quality_gates.speech: Use fixed baseline/candidate outputs and identical existing scorer settings. WER must not increase, speaker similarity and available UTMOS must not decrease; report repeat/coverage limitations.
quality_gates.numerical: Exact-shape graph-only changes require eager/replay numerical and state-ownership checks.

performance_gate: C16/C32 improvement must persist across repeated served comparisons; retain measured variation and latency tradeoffs. No global optimum claim.
inconclusive: Missing required quality, environment identity or matched comparison evidence prevents PASS.
